name: Hospital Logistics Audit
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 50-page hospital operations report: 12,400 admitted patients (page 3), 6 surgical wards (page 5), total surgeries performed 3,150 (page 8), average length of stay 4.2 days (page 12), emergency visits 18,700 (page 16), staff count 940 (page 22), annual operating budget $85M (page 30), infection rate 1.7% (page 38).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
